note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative; the hierarchy is a user-supplied ordering and implies no rule of precedence.

presets.name: baseline-illustrative
presets.description: Five parts (term, article, hierarchy, definitions section, supplied definition) joined only by plain relations; the marker runs from the term through the article's band (Level 3) and the definitions' band (Level 2) to the definition, which enlarges.

presets.name: contrast-or-alternative
presets.description: Substantive alternative: four user-supplied levels with the definitions section at Level 1 and the article at Level 4; the traversal runs the other way (from the definition back to the term); the hierarchy is the focus; the term–definition link is supplied as a sequence (arrowed) while the other relationships stay plain relations.
